subject: Dragon Shrine
text: Exchanging 8 Dragon Eggs at the Dragon Shrine scatters them across the world again, so waiting until later prevents missing treasure.

evidence.quote: If you walk south, you can visit the Dragon Shrine, where you can exchange your 8 Dragon Eggs for a great reward.  However, I would wait until later to do that, because the Dragon Eggs will scatter across the world again, and prevent you from getting some treasure later in the game.
